definitions.explanation: Equipment worn to protect the body from injury or hazards, such as helmets, goggles, gloves, and masks used in workplaces and sports.

examples.japanese: {作業中|さぎょうちゅう}は{保護具|ほごぐ}の{着用|ちゃくよう}が{義務|ぎむ}だ。
examples.english: Wearing protective gear is mandatory during work.

examples.japanese: {薬品|やくひん}を{扱|あつか}うときは、{手袋|てぶくろ}やゴーグルなどの{保護具|ほごぐ}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: When handling chemicals, protective gear such as gloves and goggles is essential.

notes:
A general term for equipment worn to protect the body. Built from {保護|ほご} (protection) and {具|ぐ} (implement; gear).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保護具|ほごぐ}を{着用|ちゃくよう}する: to wear protective gear
- {保護具|ほごぐ}を{外|はず}す: to take off protective gear
- {安全|あんぜん}{保護具|ほごぐ}: safety protective equipment

RELATED WORDS:
- {防具|ぼうぐ}: protective gear (esp. in martial arts)
- {防護服|ぼうごふく}: protective clothing; hazmat suit
